photos.c: Built for speed! Lewis Samuel sets off for a lightening tour of Copthall Stadium at the final BAL match. His best of 46.53 dates back to 1990, the year he reached the semi-final stage of the European Games at Split.
Below: The long relay boys keep us well in touch as Lewis Samue (47.8) sends Dave Nolan (46.6) off to maximum points at Birmingham.
